notes.title: IDB V 1.1: Level Editor + Practice == workshop, New Workshop features!
notes.notes:
The level editor and practice modes have been merged, into a new mode, "Workshop". In this mode, you can manage your custom levels. You can also now upload and download levels from steams workshop! From this screen, you can also chose to play or even modify existing levels! Enjoy~!

For now these features are only available on the test branch. If you don't know how to do that, go into the steam properties of the game, and select that branch. I've made it a branch, because, of course, if there's any bugs, you can also switch back to the old version. At the moment it's only available for windows, but shortly, I'll make a Linux port as well.

notes.title: Announcement For Level Creators and Potention Custom Game Creators~!
notes.notes:
Hey all,
IDB features the tool I created for myself to create the levels of IDB. I hope you like it~ I know it looks complicated, but feel free to dig through the current level code to see how I did things and learn from that! If you ever need any help with any of it, I will gladly answer any questions. I haven't created a guide yet, but I do plan to eventually have one online if there is enough interest for it. Most importantly, I will be listening to all of you, as you all use it, so I know what things would need to be explained and emphasized in said guide.

Aside from that, I would like to also announce, that if you create a level or character that meets our quality standards, we will add them to the game! Just send me your content, and I will adjust things as needed and supply them via Steam's update system. This way everyone will get to play your level! As for custom games, well, the best way I decided for that to work, would be to add your game as an add-on to IDB. This way users will get to control if they want to install your version of the game!

I have designed the DreamBattle engine to be as flexible as possible. If new features are required, I will modify it as needed. But don't be afraid to let me know if you have a feature you need, or if something isn't working the way you need it to!

Thanks,
~Anna
